''See also: [[Shuffles Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Shuffles is a small, stout creature known as an [[Elderspawn]] and a spawn of [[Othaghor]]. Standing roughly one foot tall, it resembles a stout man equipped with undersized bat-like wings and claws. Its physical appearance is characterized by pitch-black eyes filled with hatred and a mouth composed of writhing tentacles or tendrils. The creature possesses a deep, booming, and ominous voice that can sound like an earthquake or the voice of doom. Shuffles often communicates by shouting, bellowing, or whispering, and it frequently repeats the words of others. While it spends much of its time sleeping under a blanket in a cage, it tends to wake when danger is near or when it is hungry or bored. Shuffles has a penchant for malicious, deep laughter and often appears near [[Calder]], sometimes perching on his head or shoulders. Although it can be difficult to restrain, requiring multiple people to force it back into its cage, it is fed fish on a daily basis by [[Calder]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Shuffles is a pudgy green monster and [[dark figure]] characterized by black eyes that glare with hate. This [[Elderspawn]] possesses stubby, leathery, bat-like wings that buzz like a hummingbird's and features a mouth consisting of a nest of tentacles. The creature is also described as having tendrils for a mouth.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|As a lesser [[Elderspawn]], Shuffles possesses little intelligence and does not experience time in the same way as humans. The creature interacts with [[Calder]], often following him or resting on his shoulder, and reacts to imminent danger by laughing. It is known to shout, slap [[Calder]], and use a deep, masculine voice for growling or laughing.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Shuffles can fly and is capable of mimicking sounds, echoing speech, or repeating what others say. The creature uses a resonant voice to shout, bellow, and growl with the sound of a malevolent earthquake. Additionally, it has the power to unlatch cages through bars and can use words to exert power.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Life with Calder}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Shuffles is a [[Bellowing Horror]] characterized as a [[dark figure]] with black eyes, stubby wings, and a nest of tentacles for a mouth.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c3">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 3</ref> This creature lives alongside [[Calder]] and is kept in a darkened cage where it can be heard talking in its sleep.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c5">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c9">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 9</ref> Primarily sleeping during the day, Shuffles eats [[worms]] and possesses wings that buzz like those of a hummingbird.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c7">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c9" /><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c19">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 19</ref> The creature is capable of flight and can mimic sounds by echoing speech or repeating what others say.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c17">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 17</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c18">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c25">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 25</ref> Shuffles can produce a growl like a malevolent earthquake and possesses a deep, masculine laugh.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c19" /><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c21">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 21</ref> Often seen flapping along behind [[Calder]], this monstrosity has eyes that glare with black hate.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c21" /><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c27">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 27</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Elderspawn in the rigging}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Shuffles is a caged creature that laughs whenever danger approaches.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c7">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 7</ref> A pet received by [[Calder]] during his childhood, this bat-winged [[Elderspawn]] frequently interacts with him.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c12">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c13">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 13</ref> While in the rigging, the creature was observed gnawing on a fishbone.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c20">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 20</ref> This pudgy green monster possesses a deep, resonant masculine voice and joins in with rumbling laughter.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c21">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 21</ref><ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c24">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 24</ref> Despite such a booming tone, Shuffles is considered a lesser [[Elderspawn]] with little intelligence.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c23">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 23</ref>}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Inside its darkened cage in the corner, Shuffles murmured, “Kill for it....”<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c5" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Shuffles leaned closer to Calder’s ear, growling with the voice of a malevolent earthquake: “EEEAAAATTT.”<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c19" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|“SCARED,” Shuffles bellowed, and Calder remembered the drawbacks that came with his enhanced hearing.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c20" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|“OURS!” Shuffles shouted in Calder’s ear.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c23" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|s shoulder. “GAVE UP,” Shuffles screamed into his ear.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24" />}}
